# Pyro Studio - Privacy-First Android Utilities & AI Engine Ecosystem

> Pyro Studio develops high-performance, on-device AI tools and status bar productivity utilities for Android devices. All applications process data 100% locally on-device without cloud tracking or user account requirements.

## Core Applications

- [VehereGo](https://choicenew.github.io/pyropub/veherego/index.html): Android status bar island & Live Activity hub. Features automatic parcel pickup code extraction (Cainiao, SF Express, Hive Box, Meituan) via on-device OCR, PKPass digital wallet management, universal lunar calendar, and smart course schedules.
- [PyroMagma Academic](https://choicenew.github.io/pyropub/pyromagma/index.html): AI-driven academic research reader. Features card-swiping paper feeds (ArXiv, IEEE, Nature, Science, PubMed), interactive full-text RAG Q&A, multi-engine smooth translation, and Zotero / WebDAV cloud sync.
- [PyroMagma Reader](https://choicenew.github.io/pyropub/pyromagma/reader.html): Premier Legado (开源阅读) alternative for web novels, raw manga, and ebooks. Features on-device AI neural translation and live manga speech bubble OCR directly inside the reader.
- [YourCallYourRule](https://choicenew.github.io/pyropub/yourcallyourrule/index.html): Powerful, highly customizable call & SMS blocker for Android. Features blacklists, whitelists, regex rules, online subscriptions, STIR/SHAKEN caller verification, WebDAV cloud backup, and a web scraping plugin engine.

## Navigation & Documentation

- [Application Hub Portal](https://choicenew.github.io/pyropub/nav/index.html): Comprehensive directory of all 4 Pyro Studio Android applications.
- [Full LLM Documentation](https://choicenew.github.io/pyropub/llms-full.txt): Complete feature specifications, rule syntax, and FAQ answers for AI retrieval.
